subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR require visible latest-head proof for legacy no-code SQLite diagnostics before merge, or can maintainers accept source/test proof for that compatibility path?
rationale: The code shape follows the predecessor maintainer direction, but the remaining legacy fallback changes upgraded persisted-state behavior and the contributor has not shown live latest-head proof for that path.

options.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code diagnostics_json row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds on the current head.

options.title: Accept Source And Test Proof
options.body: Maintainers can waive external proof and accept the source/test evidence for the legacy path, while owning the persisted-state compatibility risk.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup Elsewhere
options.body: Pause this branch and move no-code legacy cleanup to doctor or migration-owned code if runtime invalidation is not the desired upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code diagnostics_json row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds on the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: They gave the predecessor's explicit-marker direction and have recent history in the same plugin registry/discovery area.
